# EasingMode

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Animation` · enum

```csharp
public enum EasingMode
```

How an [`Easing`](Easing.md)'s curve is applied over the animation.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="in"></a>`In` | The curve as defined: slow at the start, fast at the end. |
| <a name="out"></a>`Out` | The curve reflected: fast at the start, slow at the end. |
| <a name="inout"></a>`InOut` | The curve in on the first half, and out on the second. |
| <a name="outin"></a>`OutIn` | The curve out on the first half, and in on the second. |
